title: Static Broad Cap and Short Limbed Mushroom Folk
description: One newly authored complete static fictional mushroom-folk character. A single continuous shared-loop body forms the broad potbelly, short facial neck, spreading pale cap underside and closed asymmetric rust-coloured crown. Two short independently shaped bent legs end in broad complete grounded feet, while two bent arms terminate in full palms and three blunt short fingers each. Two small inset eye appearances and a short mouth sit below the overhanging cap. Unlike an old natural funnel fungus with one grounded stem, this is an original standing biped silhouette with body, limbs, hands and face; unlike the old tall treefolk it has no bark trunk, root forks or crown branches. No natural fungus or old character mesh imported, all coordinates new. Three opaque matte PBR appearances, metres Z up and whole horizontal bounds centred, one fictional character model zero scenes. Static art only; no species identification, botanical accuracy, edible or poisonous classification, ecology, biological behavior, walking, physical character simulation, rigging, animation or interaction made. No manufacture or safety capability.
